note: One entry per person in the network — all 65 who make di.iiii, not only the ones with rooms yet. `works` (shape: {url,title,line,space,project}) are addresses on di.iiii where their work already stands; `elsewhere` is the handle the roster used to point at. Generated from network-directions/data/inventory.json (52-person roster) via the MIX build's lib/data.mjs, then committed here as static data. build.mjs turns this into pages/<slug>.html and one di-space.<slug>.json each, via room-template.mjs's renderRoom(). Two works (azd and br_id_ge) are shared by more than one person, which is what draws the lines in a room's field. When a person takes their room over in Studio, remove their manifest from di-space.space.json `projects` — the engine never deletes, and a declared page would overwrite what they make.
